player_prompt.intro:
Yin aa Player {player_id}. Yin aya cɔl Guess The Number.
Yin akɛ̈ɛ̈c gɛ̈l kuɔ̈t thiɛ̈k kɛ̈k ë bɛ̈n thiɛ̈k ë gɛ̈l kuɔ̈t {min_number} na {max_number} within {max_turns} wɛ̈t.
Kɛ̈n yin pɛ̈i yin cɔl, kaŋ de game ayɔ̈ɔ̈k yin ku jɔl ŋɛ̈k nhial 'higher' or 'lower'.
Yin akɛ̈ɛ̈c pɛ̈i yin cɔl ku jɔl ŋɛ̈k. Ŋɛ̈k de kuɔ̈t ee ku jɔl kuɔ̈t ayɔ̈ɔ̈k yin ku jɔl ŋɛ̈k. Kɛ̈n yin cɔl, [5].
Kɛ̈n yin aya, lɔ̈k de yin cɔl ayɔ̈ɔ̈k yin ku jɔl ŋɛ̈k thiɛ̈k. Yin akɛ̈ɛ̈c lɔ̈k ee lɔ̈k de yin cɔl ku jɔl yin cɔl ee ŋɛ̈k kuɔ̈t ku bɛ̈n.
Yin pɛ̈i yin cɔl.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ciɛ̈l de ŋɛ̈k kuɔ̈t. Player {player_id} akɛ̈ɛ̈c bɛ̈n ku jɔl '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jäk mi /ci lät. Ŋar {player_id} cɛ nämbär ŋa̱c raar kä min ca lat ɛ ram in ŋari jɛ.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Jäk mi /ci̱ gɔaa. Ci ŋar {player_id} ku lɛ guic ɛn nämbär in ca mat piny ɛ ŋa̱a̱rkɛ i̱ bi jɛ la̱t kɛ gua̱thdɛ kärɔa.

game_message.target_higher: Kä pek in görkɛ ɛ di̱t.
game_message.target_lower: Kä pek in görkɛ ɛ mi̱ kuiy.

outcome.win: Cää tɛth lɔaac! Ci̱ nämbär in ca car ɛ thuɔ̱k ŋa̱c.
outcome.turn_limit: Thiɛ̈k de kɛ̈k ë bɛ̈n. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
